# A11Y Pros

> A11Y Pros is a digital accessibility consultancy. Senior, IAAP-certified consultants and native screen reader users perform 100% manual WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA audits, website and PDF remediation, VPAT/ACR authoring, and accessibility consulting for websites, SaaS platforms, and mobile apps. Services support compliance with the ADA, Section 508, the European Accessibility Act (EAA), EN 301 549, AODA, and the Accessible Canada Act, including urgent help for businesses facing ADA website lawsuits and demand letters.

A11Y Pros does not sell accessibility overlays or widgets; all testing and remediation is done by people, at the code level. A free 30-minute consultation is available for new clients.

## Services

- [Web Accessibility Services](https://a11ypros.com/services): Overview of accessibility consulting, auditing, and remediation for WCAG, Section 508, and ADA website compliance.
- [WCAG Compliance Auditing](https://a11ypros.com/services/wcag-compliance-auditing): Manual WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA audits of websites, SaaS platforms, and mobile apps for ADA, Section 508, EAA, and AODA compliance.
- [Website Remediation](https://a11ypros.com/services/website-remediation): Code-level fixes that bring websites into conformance with WCAG 2.1 A and AA.
- [VPAT & ACR Authoring](https://a11ypros.com/services/vpat-acr-authoring): Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates and Accessibility Conformance Reports for government and enterprise procurement.
- [Web Accessibility Consulting](https://a11ypros.com/services/web-accessibility-consulting): Expert guidance on WCAG, EAA, Section 508, and ADA compliance for product, design, and engineering teams.
- [PDF Remediation](https://a11ypros.com/services/pdf-remediation): Evaluating, fixing, and verifying PDF documents so they are accessible to screen reader users and meet compliance standards.
- [Figma Design & UI/UX Accessibility Audits](https://a11ypros.com/services/figma-design-audits): Design-phase audits of Figma files, component libraries, and design systems to catch color contrast, focus state, and component issues before development.
- [ADA Website Compliance & Litigation Protection](https://a11ypros.com/services/ada-litigation-support): Audits, code-level remediation, and VPAT/ACR documentation for businesses at risk of, or responding to, ADA Title III website lawsuits and demand letters.
- [Accessibility Partnerships for Agencies & Dev Teams](https://a11ypros.com/services/accessibility-partnerships-for-agencies-dev-teams): White-label audits and VPATs, subcontracted accessibility work, and team augmentation for agencies and development teams.
- [Pricing](https://a11ypros.com/pricing): Rates for manual WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA audits, hourly technical consulting, website remediation, and VPAT authoring.

## Tools

- [Audit & VPAT Scope Estimator](https://a11ypros.com/vpat-estimator): Interactive calculator for WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA audit scope, Section 508 requirements, and estimated VPAT/ACR timeline.
- [Free Manual Teaser Audit](https://a11ypros.com/free-accessibility-audit): Request a free manual review of key keyboard and screen reader flows on your site, delivered as a video breakdown.

## Accessibility Laws and Standards

- [Accessibility Compliance](https://a11ypros.com/compliance): Overview of web accessibility standards and how A11Y Pros helps organizations meet them.
- [WCAG](https://a11ypros.com/compliance/web-content-accessibility-guidelines): The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines, the internationally recognized standard behind most accessibility laws.
- [Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)](https://a11ypros.com/compliance/the-americans-with-disabilities-act): The U.S. civil rights law that courts apply to websites and digital services.
- [Section 508](https://a11ypros.com/compliance/section-508): The Rehabilitation Act requirement that federal agencies and contractors provide accessible technology.
- [EN 301 549](https://a11ypros.com/compliance/en-301-549): The European standard for digital accessibility in public sector procurement.
- [Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA)](https://a11ypros.com/compliance/aoda): Ontario's accessibility law for public and private sector organizations.
- [Accessible Canada Act (ACA)](https://a11ypros.com/compliance/the-accessible-canada-act-aca): Canada's federal law aiming for a barrier-free Canada by 2040.
